verdict.rationale: The docs point developers to official SDKs for a type-safe integration. The first-party perplexity-py repo backs this up with type definitions for all request params and responses, sync and async clients, SSE streaming, automatic retries, typed API errors and a concrete search usage example. A published OpenAPI spec also supports SDK-based building. Missing for 10: evidence of SDKs beyond Python (the docs say "one of our" but name no other languages), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
